class Impl:
    def parse(self, argv):
        values = {}
        flags = {}
        positional = []
        i = 0
        n = len(argv)
        only_positional = False
        while i < n:
            item = argv[i]
            if only_positional:
                positional.append(item)
                i += 1
                continue
            if item == "--":
                only_positional = True
                i += 1
                continue
            if item.startswith("--"):
                body = item[2:]
                if "=" in body:

                    values.setdefault(key, []).append(value)

                key = body
                nxt = argv[i+1] if i+1 < n else None
                if nxt is not None and not nxt.startswith("--"):
